problem:

$$
f(x)=\frac{x}{y},\,x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}],

Suppose a transformation $\boldsymbol{f}:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R^m$ is defined by 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14094602/assets/17588b058b1e1fe934e06679836234f0ef35fe4484a558fcc3ec3b2aafbd2620.png) 

where $f_1,f_2,\ldots,f_m$ are scalar functions with $n$ variables. If $\boldsymbol f$ is differentiable at $\mathbf{x},$ then the total derivative of $\boldsymbol f$ at $\mathbf{x},$ denoted $\boldsymbol{f}'(\mathbf{x}),$ is given by the $m \times n$ matrix

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14094602/assets/613ba027e9564812a8e050efd69fd98fff3f614f7d2ec69eeb787c628ccabd12.png)

In our case, we have the following:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14094602/assets/87579b882ca6d8c92d4a7adfed575873fd07c36ab20251722c2cc8fc0f0328e8.png)

First, we compute the partial derivatives:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x} & =\frac{∂}{∂x}({x}^{2}y)=2xy, & \,\frac{∂f}{∂y} & =\frac{∂}{∂y}({x}^{2}y)={x}^{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have
